Assessments for Entrepreneurs

Scoring, objective reports, and bespoke guidance that help Entrepreneurs (1) fundraise more quickly and efficiently, and (2) improve their success as Entrepreneurs and leaders.

Two assessments. One honest picture. Both free to start.

01

Is your venture viable and ready for fundraising?

Investors typically decide within minutes and rarely explain their reasoning. The Venture Score applies the same criteria sophisticated investors use — problem, market, team, sales and marketing, financials, defensibility, evidence — to give you an honest, structured assessment of where you stand, along with clear guidance on how to strengthen it.

Start Your Free Venture Assessment
Your Venture Assessment

The Venture Assessment measures the capital-readiness, investor appeal, and likelihood of success of your venture.

  • YOUR VENTURE SCORE — an objective, evidence-based assessment produced using the same objective analytical framework for every venture based on 11 pillars for measuring the likelihood of success.
  • YOUR SUMMARY REPORT — a clear assessment of your principal strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, and capital-readiness gaps.
  • YOUR BESPOKE GUIDANCE — a prioritized action plan identifying the improvements most likely to increase your score, strengthen your venture, and improve your attractiveness to investors.

Why sign up

Five reasons founders finish the questionnaire

The assessment takes one focused sitting. What you get back is the thing most founders never get: objective, candid, and valuable insights into your venture's present likelihood to raise capital and succeed.

No. Reason What you get
1 Improve your pitch and your venture’s capital-readiness before you pitch investors. Get clear answers about your strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats, and capital-readiness gaps. Upload or record your pitch and receive feedback on its clarity, credibility, flow, brevity, and persuasive power. Practice responding to the difficult questions investors are likely to ask.
2 Get bespoke guidance that accelerates your success After completing the questionnaire, receive an AI-powered Summary Report and prioritized guidance. Members receive detailed reports and ongoing bespoke guidance that helps them close critical gaps and improve their ventures.
3 Get matched with relevant investors looking for ventures like yours Once you are capital-ready, RegenEngine uses your assessment, score, stage, sector, geography, funding needs, and other relevant criteria to identify the investors most likely to be a strong fit.
4 Use your time, money, relationships, and resources efficiently Stop pitching before you are ready and stop pursuing investors who are unlikely to invest. Know when you are ready — and whom you should approach.
5 Build the right team, raise capital, and expand your market RegenEngine helps you strengthen more than fundraising. Its assessments, guidance, resources, and matching capabilities help you build your team, improve your product, sharpen your market strategy, and generate revenue.

Results depend on the venture, execution, and market conditions. RegenEngine provides scoring, analysis, guidance, and matching tools; it does not guarantee funding, terms, or business outcomes.

The assessment

Investment Decision Pillars

Test your venture using the analytical pillars sophisticated investors apply when making investment decisions. Every pillar is evaluated using your answers, supporting documents, and available evidence — not unsupported adjectives or promotional claims.

No. Pillar What it tests
1 Venture Information What are you building, for whom, and how does it make money?
2 Document Analysis, Validation & Organization Do your documents back up what you told us?
3 Team, Leadership & Management Why this team, and can it execute and scale?
4 Problem-Solution Is the problem real, urgent and worth paying to solve?
5 Market Opportunity, Size & Growth How big, how fast, and why now?
6 SWOT Analysis Do you see your own weaknesses as clearly as your strengths?
7 Positioning & Competitive Analysis Why you, and why not the incumbent?
8 Sales & Marketing How will the venture reach, acquire, convert, retain, and expand customers?
9 Financial Analysis Are the numbers realistic and the assumptions defensible?
10 IP, Defensibility & Moats What intellectual property, structural advantages, network effects, data, relationships, or other barriers protect the venture from competitors?
11 Regenerative Impact Building regenerative, ethical and transformational companies — optional, but scored if you opt in, and recommended if you're seeking impact capital.

FAQs

Quick answers

When do I see my score?

Once you submit the complete questionnaire — a score built on half the picture would mislead you, so we score only after you finish. You get bullet-point feedback at the end of each section as you go.

Uploading documents?

Uploading documents is voluntary, however, uploading documents can save time in answering the questionnaire. Even though you control who sees your score, assessment, and data, we recommend that you don't upload anything that is confidential. Also, documents show preparation, and having your documents reviewed is of significant value. Moreover, failure to either answer questions or upload documents can impact your score.

Who can see my answers?

You do. Nothing is visible to anyone outside RegenEngine until you set your permissions — you control sharing item by item, audience by audience, and our internal access is permissioned and logged.

Is RegenEngine a portfolio company of ARIIVL? What is ARIIVL?

Yes. ARIIVL (Advanced Regenerative Integrated Intelligence Venture Lab) — www.ariivl.com — is an AI-powered venture builder of Regenerative Enterprises, Projects, and Solutions (“REPS”). ARIIVL also invests in and provides resources to help external portfolio companies succeed.

Is it really free?

Yes, your Score, Assessment, and Summary Report are free. The Detailed Reports may be ordered à la carte, but are included in the memberships. Membership also includes bespoke AI-powered guidance, events, workshops, and matching.

What if my score is low?

Then you've learned something most founders learn the hard way, after months of failed pitches. The report tells you which gaps matter most and what to do about them. As a member, you can fix them, re-submit your answers and documents, and improve your score.

Who scores my venture?

An AI engine built on institutional investment criteria, applied consistently to every venture. Every score is tied to evidence in your answers and documents, so you can see why you received the score you did.

If my venture isn’t a regenerative or impact company, does the "Regenerative Impact" pillar affect my score or matching?

We want all ventures to receive the value RegenEngine provides, so the Regenerative Impact pillar is optional. If you opt out, this pillar has no effect on your score — but you will be matched with fewer regenerative and impact investors. If you opt in, this pillar is scored and counts toward your total score. We, and many other investors, believe the most successful companies will be regenerative and will transform industries and help create a thriving world. We offer this pillar because a growing share of capital cares about positive impact — if you want to attract impact investors, opt in.

What is the Entrepreneurial DNA Assessment, and when will it be available?

A separate assessment of your personality and characteristics rather than your venture. This assessment includes traits and habits that predict whether a founder has what it takes to succeed, including vision, commitment, tenacity, courage, leadership, judgment, creativity, and resilience. This assessment provides developmental and behavioral advice to help you increase your strengths and overcome weaknesses. This assessment also helps you screen and choose team members for a complementary blend of strengths. Free score and summary report. Detailed reports and bespoke AI-powered guidance are provided with your membership.

Does RegenEngine replace an investor’s due diligence?

RegenEngine scores, screens, analyzes, and cross-checks every venture against evidence in its answers and documents, so investors get more relevant introductions and spend less time in top-of-funnel review and with ventures that don't meet their criteria. RegenEngine complements investors' own formal due diligence process, but does not replace it.

Do I need to be capital-ready to start?

No — that's the point. Getting objective scores, reports and guidance helps you become capital-ready. Starting early accelerates your capital-readiness and increases the efficiency of your fundraising.

An ARIIVL Portfolio Company

Why RegenEngine exists

RegenEngine exists to make the quality of a venture legible — to its founders first, and then to the investors and service providers who can move it forward.

On this page Why we built it Our relationship with ARIIVL How the platform works What we hold to

Why we built it

Founders raising capital are judged constantly and told almost nothing. Investors see hundreds of ventures and can properly diligence a handful. Service providers who could genuinely help are introduced at the wrong moment, to the wrong company, through the wrong channel.

RegenEngine replaces that guesswork with a structured assessment. Ten pillars, consistently scored, produce a Venture Score and a Founder Score, a written report, and an action plan ranked by the impact each step has on the score. The same structure then drives matching, so the conversations that happen are the ones worth having.

Our relationship with ARIIVL

RegenEngine is an ARIIVL Portfolio Company. ARIIVL invests in and builds ventures working on regenerative outcomes; RegenEngine is one of them, incubated inside the ARIIVL platform and operated as its own company with its own team, roadmap and customer commitments.

Practically, that means three things for you:

  • The assessment methodology draws on ARIIVL's own diligence practice — the questions are the ones a serious investor asks.
  • ARIIVL's network of investors, capital providers and service providers informs who is on the platform to be matched with.
  • Being a portfolio company does not give ARIIVL a window into your confidential material. The same permissions, access controls, audit trail and conflicts check that apply to our own team apply here.

If you want to understand how a specific piece of information is handled, the Privacy Policy sets it out, and Contact Us reaches a person.

How the platform works

You create an account and tell us whether you are an entrepreneur or executive seeking venture financing, an investor or capital provider, a service provider — or more than one. That choice shapes the questionnaire you are given and the matching you take part in.

You complete the questionnaire section by section, uploading a document or answering in your own words. You review and edit before each submission, and you get bullet-point feedback as you go. When the questionnaire is complete, your score, report and action plan are released together.

From there, twelve weighted criteria determine your matches. Investors and service providers set their own weightings and a minimum matching-score threshold, and outreach runs through connection requests rather than unsolicited direct messages.

What we hold to

Three things we don't compromise on

01

Honest before flattering

A score that tells you what you want to hear is worthless. We would rather be useful.

02

Confidential by construction

Permissions, access controls and an audit trail — not a promise in a footer.

03

Regenerative by intent

We assess ventures on whether the model gives back more than it takes.

Draft for legal review. Last updated 18 August 2026. This text is a working draft prepared to complete the page structure; it must be reviewed and approved by counsel before launch.

1. Acceptance of these terms

By creating an account or using the RegenEngine website and platform (the “Service”) you confirm that you have read, understand and accept these Terms and Conditions of Service and Use and the Privacy Policy. If you do not accept them, do not use the Service.

If you use the Service on behalf of an organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to bind that organisation to these terms.

2. Your account

  • You must provide accurate information and keep it current.
  • You are responsible for keeping your credentials secure and for activity under your account.
  • Accounts are personal; do not share access with anyone outside your organisation.
  • Tell us promptly at security@regenengine.com if you suspect unauthorised use.

3. Your content and confidentiality

You retain all ownership of the answers, documents and other material you submit (“Your Content”). You grant RegenEngine a limited licence to host, process and analyse Your Content solely to operate the Service and produce your score, report, guidance and matches.

RegenEngine will use reasonable commercial efforts to keep Your Content confidential. Internal access is permissioned and logged, and a conflicts check is run before review. RegenEngine does not enter into separate confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements in respect of the Service.

You control the viewing permissions applied to Your Content — you choose the information you desire to share and who sees your information: Founders, Investors, Service Providers, ARIIVL Investment Team, Members Only, All or None — and you may change them at any time. Material you elect to publish or share is no longer confidential.

Independent development: other users may submit similar ideas, and RegenEngine and its affiliates may work with ventures in comparable sectors. Nothing here restricts that, provided Your Content is not used in breach of these terms.

4. Assessment, scores and reports

Scores, reports, action plans and guidance are informational only. They are not investment advice, legal advice, tax advice, an offer, a solicitation, or a valuation, and they do not guarantee that you will raise capital or achieve any outcome.

Results depend on the accuracy and completeness of what you submit. Scores are released once the relevant questionnaire is complete, and the methodology and weightings may be updated over time.

5. Matching, connections and outreach

Matching uses weighted criteria set by you and by the counterparty. Investors and service providers may set a minimum matching-score threshold that limits who may contact them.

Outreach runs through connection requests. Do not attempt to circumvent the connection-request mechanism, and do not use the Service for unsolicited bulk messaging. Message allowances depend on your subscription plan.

6. Subscriptions, plans and payment

  • Some features, including elements of the dashboard, top matches and message allowances, depend on your plan.
  • Fees, billing periods and renewal terms are those shown at purchase.
  • Unless stated otherwise, subscriptions renew automatically and may be cancelled for the next period.
  • Fees are non-refundable except where required by law.

7. Acceptable use

You agree not to: submit false or misleading information; upload material you have no right to share; upload malware; scrape, reverse engineer or resell the Service; misrepresent your identity or role; harass other users; or use the Service unlawfully.

8. Intellectual property

The Service, including the assessment methodology, the 10 pillars, the weighted criteria, scoring models, report formats, software, and all trademarks, are owned by RegenEngine or its licensors. Your report is licensed to you for your own business use; the underlying methodology is not.

9. Third-party services and links

The Service may integrate or link to third-party services. We are not responsible for their content, availability or practices, and your use of them is governed by their terms.

10. Disclaimers and limitation of liability

The Service is provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind to the maximum extent permitted by law. To that same extent, RegenEngine is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, or for lost profits, revenue, data, goodwill or anticipated savings, and our aggregate liability is limited to the amounts you paid for the Service in the twelve months preceding the claim.

11. Suspension and termination

You may close your account at any time. We may suspend or terminate access for breach of these terms or where required by law. On termination, your right to use the Service ends; sections intended to survive — including confidentiality, intellectual property, disclaimers and liability — continue to apply.

12. Changes, governing law and contact

We may update these terms and will post the revised version with a new “last updated” date; material changes will be notified to account holders. Governing law and venue: [jurisdiction to be confirmed by counsel].

Draft for legal review. Last updated 18 August 2026. Prepared to complete the page structure; must be reviewed and approved by counsel, and reconciled with the applicable data-protection regimes, before launch.

1. Who we are

RegenEngine (“we”, “us”) operates this website and the RegenEngine assessment and matching platform. RegenEngine is an ARIIVL Portfolio Company. We are the controller of the personal information described here. Contact: privacy@regenengine.com.

2. Information we collect

  • Account information — name, email address, role (entrepreneur or executive, investor or capital provider, service provider), organisation, and password credentials or the identifier from a single sign-on provider you choose.
  • Assessment content — your questionnaire answers and any documents you upload.
  • Matching and messaging — weighted criteria, thresholds, connection requests and messages sent through the platform.
  • Billing — plan, transaction records. Card details are handled by our payment processor, not stored by us.
  • Technical — device, browser, IP address, and log and usage data.
  • Marketing preferences — newsletter opt-in status and communication history.

3. How we use it

  • To create and administer your account and provide the Service.
  • To produce your Venture Score, Founder Score, report, action plan and guidance.
  • To generate matches and to operate connection requests and messaging.
  • To run conflicts checks and maintain the access audit trail.
  • To secure the platform, prevent abuse and meet legal obligations.
  • To send the newsletter and product updates where you have opted in — you may opt out at any time.

We do not sell your personal information.

4. Legal bases

Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we rely on: performance of a contract with you; legitimate interests in operating, securing and improving the Service; consent for marketing communications and non-essential cookies; and compliance with legal obligations.

5. Who can see your assessment content

You control the viewing permission on your material — you choose the information you desire to share and who sees your information: Founders, Investors, Service Providers, ARIIVL Investment Team, Members Only, All or None. Within RegenEngine, access to your answers and uploads is permissioned: team members cannot open or share them without a granted permission, every access is logged, and a conflicts check runs before review.

We use reasonable commercial efforts to keep your confidential information confidential. We do not sign separate confidentiality agreements in respect of the Service.

6. Sharing with third parties

  • Service providers acting on our instructions — hosting, email delivery, analytics, payment processing, malware scanning — under contract.
  • Counterparties you choose — when you accept a connection request or publish material at a permission level that includes them.
  • Legal — where required by law, or to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
  • Corporate transactions — in connection with a merger, acquisition or asset sale, subject to this policy.

7. Retention

We keep account and assessment information for as long as your account is active and thereafter only as long as needed for the purposes described here or to meet legal, accounting or reporting requirements. You may request deletion; some records are retained where law requires.

8. Security

We apply technical and organisational measures including encryption in transit, role-based access control, permissioned internal access with audit logging, malware scanning of uploads, and regular review. No system is perfectly secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

9. Your rights and choices

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, port or restrict the processing of your personal information, to object to processing based on legitimate interests, and to withdraw consent. Exercise them at privacy@regenengine.com; you also have the right to complain to your supervisory authority.

10. Cookies

We use cookies that are strictly necessary for the site to function, and — with your consent — analytics cookies that help us understand how the site is used. You can manage cookies in your browser settings.

11. International transfers, children and contact

Where information is transferred across borders, we use appropriate safeguards. The Service is not directed at children under 16. Questions or requests: privacy@regenengine.com, or use the Contact Us page.
